top_signals.title: BlackRock Seeks to Break ETF Mold With Private-Market Hybrid
top_signals.summary: BlackRock Inc. is pushing to redraw the boundaries of the $16 trillion US exchange-traded funds industry with a novel investment vehicle that would marry two of Wall Street’s biggest obsessions: the trading ease of ETFs and the allure of private markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Strategy buys $33M in Bitcoin, spends $228M on STRC buybacks
top_signals.summary: Strategy bought 485 Bitcoin last week while repurchasing 2.28 million STRC preferred shares, funding most of the transactions through MSTR stock sales.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Banks are banning AI agents over security... and competition concerns
top_signals.summary: AI agents are set to automate everyday banking tasks — but banks aren’t ready to give up control of the customer relationship just yet.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
